scheme_name: PMMSY: Three wheeler with Ice Box including e-rickshaws for fish vending - Gujarat
description:
The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) is a significant initiative launched by the Government of India to enhance the fishery sector in the country. 

The scheme was launched on September 10, 2020. 

It aims to promote sustainable and responsible fishing practices. 

The PMMSY is designed to increase fish production and productivity. 

One of the specific components of this scheme is the provision for three-wheelers with ice boxes, including e-rickshaws for fish vending. 

This initiative is particularly relevant in states like Gujarat, where fish vending is a vital source of livelihood for many families. 

The primary objective of this component is to improve the logistics and transportation of fish products. 

By providing three-wheelers equipped with ice boxes, the scheme aims to ensure that fish vendors can maintain the freshness and quality of their products. 

The initiative also seeks to enhance the income of fish vendors by providing them with better transportation facilities. 

The targeted beneficiaries of this scheme include traditional fish vendors and those involved in the fish supply chain. 

Eligibility criteria for beneficiaries include being a registered fish vendor. 

Applicants must also demonstrate a need for improved transportation facilities for their fish vending activities. 

The scheme is particularly focused on supporting marginalized communities involved in fish vending. 

The financial assistance provided under this component includes a subsidy for the purchase of three-wheelers with ice boxes. 

The subsidy amount can be up to 60 percent of the total cost of the vehicle. 

For example, if the total cost of a three-wheeler with an ice box is INR 5 lakh, the subsidy could amount to INR 3 lakh. 

This financial assistance is aimed at making the purchase of these vehicles more affordable for fish vendors. 

The application process for this scheme involves several steps. 

First, interested beneficiaries must approach the local fisheries department in their respective districts. 

They will need to fill out an application form that includes personal details and information about their fish vending activities. 

Required documents include proof of identity, proof of address, and any registration documents related to their fish vending business. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the fisheries department. 

After approval, the beneficiary will receive a sanction order for the subsidy. 

The timeline for the entire application process can vary but typically takes around 30 to 45 days from the date of submission. 

Disbursement of the subsidy is made directly to the beneficiary's bank account. 

The frequency of disbursement is generally on a one-time basis upon approval of the application. 

The implementing authority for this scheme in Gujarat is the Department of Fisheries. 

They are responsible for overseeing the implementation and monitoring of the PMMSY in the state. 

The contact details for the Department of Fisheries in Gujarat can be found on the official state government website. 

The PMMSY also includes various other components aimed at enhancing the overall fishery sector. 

These components include the establishment of fish markets and cold storage facilities. 

The scheme also promotes the use of modern fishing techniques and technologies. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 20,050 crore for the PMMSY over a period of five years. 

This budget is aimed at developing the entire fishery sector, including aquaculture and marine fisheries. 

The scheme is expected to create around 15 lakh direct and indirect jobs in the fishery sector. 

In Gujarat, the fish production has been steadily increasing, with the state contributing significantly to the national fish production. 

The PMMSY aims to further enhance this production capacity. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of sustainable fishing practices. 

It encourages fish vendors to adopt eco-friendly methods in their operations. 

The introduction of e-rickshaws as part of the transportation solution is a step towards reducing carbon emissions. 

These vehicles are not only cost-effective but also environmentally friendly. 

The PMMSY is part of the broader vision of the Government of India to promote "Atmanirbhar Bharat" or self-reliant India. 

By supporting local fish vendors, the scheme aims to boost the rural economy. 

The PMMSY also aligns with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) set by the United Nations. 

It specifically addresses goals related to poverty alleviation and sustainable consumption. 

The success of the PMMSY will be measured by the increase in fish production and the improvement in the livelihoods of fish vendors. 

Regular monitoring and evaluation will be conducted by the Department of Fisheries to assess the impact of the scheme. 

The government encourages feedback from beneficiaries to improve the implementation process. 

Overall, the PMMSY is a comprehensive scheme aimed at transforming the fishery sector in India. 

The three-wheeler with ice box initiative is a crucial component that addresses the logistical challenges faced by fish vendors. 

By providing financial assistance and modern transportation solutions, the scheme aims to uplift the livelihoods of many families involved in fish vending. 

The PMMSY represents a significant step towards enhancing the fishery sector's contribution to the Indian economy. 

With its focus on sustainability and modernization, the scheme is poised to make a lasting impact on the lives of fish vendors in Gujarat and across the country. 

The initiative is expected to not only improve incomes but also ensure better quality and availability of fish products in the market. 

As the scheme progresses, it will be essential to monitor its effectiveness and make necessary adjustments to maximize its benefits. 

The PMMSY is a testament to the government's commitment to supporting the fishery sector and promoting sustainable livelihoods. 

Through this initiative, the government aims to create a robust framework for fish vending that can withstand future challenges. 

The three-wheeler with ice box initiative is just one of the many ways the PMMSY is transforming the landscape of fish vending in India.
